워터멜론 펀치

“ Do you like watermelon? Well then do I have a drink for you! „

Watermelon PUNCH! (Korean: 워터멜론 펀치, woteomellon peonch) is Melon Soda Cookie's first Costume, released in the Summer Party at Marine Soda Bay! update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

Watermelon PUNCH, coming right up! What's that, you ask? Why, Cafe Fruit Bomber's new, limited-time summer drink! Melon Soda Cookie's all dressed up for the part, looking sweeter and fresher than the drink itself. She's been busy firing off samples of the new drink from her Soda Cannon, which now has Cookies lined up on the beach for the drink's official release! What a great way to cool off on vacation!

Trivia

  • Watermelon PUNCH! was released alongside  Summer Dancer,  Beachside Party, and  Seaside Memories.
  •  Sunset Vacation can be seen in Watermelon PUNCH!'s gacha illustration.
